item: Cross-process file lock and atomic replace; error journal converted (R176 step 1)
summary: Before: a trim and an append by two servers on one data folder lost the appended line (K4). After: file_lock (flock sidecar, msvcrt on Windows never run, shared appends, exclusive trims, unlocked fallback with one warning by file name) plus atomic_replace; the error journal uses them; tests/test_shared_file_writes.py lists every unconverted write site by module and lane.
